Selection procedure

Evidence was ranked, not blended into an opaque score

  1. Start with every component assessed by multi_gate.identification.
  2. Require exactly two significant apertures and an accepted two-quadrilateral fitter result.
  3. Prefer component-local thickness excess with a multi-arm junction over the weaker aperture-only route.
  4. Prefer candidates persisting in neighboring frames with consistent physical geometry.
  5. Inspect the source frame to reject incidental logo, border, and corner holes on a single gate.

This final visual safeguard matters: several accepted fits have reasonable numerical coverage but clearly describe one gate plus an incidental hole.

One-time conclusion

Use these seven episodes as the first focused multi-gate fitting set

The strongest starting points are 106964–106971, 106708–106736, and 106940–106941. The 107020–107026 episode is also compelling but exposes the need to strengthen the aperture-only adapter and side-support logic. The remaining three episodes are useful refinement cases. Logo/border-hole examples should become explicit negative fixtures before this ranking becomes automatic.

The complete accepted fitter population contains 43 multi-arm results and 36 aperture-only results. Human review retained 59 accepted component instances across the seven coherent episodes.
